summary: The AgencyProfileClosures component is an ASP.NET user control designed to manage the closure details of agency profiles. It includes functionalities for updating, inserting, and deleting closure records, as well as managing applied destinations and destinations lists.
purpose: To provide a user interface for managing agency profile closures, including various filters and options for handling subdisciplines and destinations.
business_rules: Restrict subdisciplines based on user session settings.
Allow insertion and updates only for editable screens.
validations: Require selection of closure type and discipline.
Ensure start date is before end date.
calculations: Calculate applied destinations based on user selections.
conditions: Check if screen is editable before allowing edits.
system_behavior: Redirects user to the current page after operations.
exceptions: Handle cancellation of data operations if user session is null.
